title: Witch in Arcane Study
description: A purple-haired witch in a long purple polka-dot dress stands on a green velvet stool inside a magical cluttered room. She reaches toward a cluster of glowing turquoise orbs while surrounded by shelves of potion bottles, framed paintings, an open spellbook, a lit red candle, scattered scrolls, and a black cat resting on a picture frame.
prompt: A purple-haired witch wearing a long purple polka-dot dress and black boots stands on a green velvet platform inside a whimsical magical study. She reaches up toward a cluster of glowing turquoise orbs floating in the air. The room has purple walls, a stained glass skylight, shelves filled with glowing potion jars, many gold-framed paintings, an open spellbook on a desk, a lit red candle, scattered scrolls hanging from the ceiling, and a black cat resting on a picture frame. Butterflies and petals float in the air, rich fantasy illustration style, detailed, atmospheric lighting
